Leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
Leaderboard.help: Top players or pairs by published Elo for the current sidebar filters.
Leaderboard.comment: @ in prompt means prompt is a key into ['SelectBoxes']['Vetted_Prompts']. {Rating_Type} is replaced from the Players/Pairs widget. Optional prompt key Output is Grid, Deal, or Info; missing Output stays Grid.

prompts.prompt: Top players by published Elo with quality and skill-gate columns.
prompts.sql:
WITH player_positions AS (
  SELECT Date, session_id, Round, Board, Player_ID_N AS Player_ID, Player_Name_N AS Player_Name,
         MasterPoints_N AS MasterPoints, {Elo_Col_N} AS Elo_R_Player,
         CASE WHEN DD_Score_NS IS NULL OR Par_NS IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DD_Score_NS >= Par_NS THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS Par_Contract_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'NS' THEN CASE WHEN BidSuit IS NOT NULL AND ParContracts IS NOT NULL AND list_contains(list_transform(ParContracts, par_contract -> par_contract.Strain), BidSuit) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Par_Suit_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'NS' AND Par_Declarer < 0 THEN CASE WHEN DD_Score_Declarer IS NOT NULL AND DD_Score_Declarer = Par_Declarer THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Sacrifice_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = 'N' THEN DD_Tricks_Diff ELSE NULL END AS TDD_Value
  FROM self
  WHERE Player_ID_N IS NOT NULL AND {Elo_Col_N} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_N})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Date, session_id, Round, Board, Player_ID_S AS Player_ID, Player_Name_S AS Player_Name,
         MasterPoints_S AS MasterPoints, {Elo_Col_S} AS Elo_R_Player,
         CASE WHEN DD_Score_NS IS NULL OR Par_NS IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DD_Score_NS >= Par_NS THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS Par_Contract_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'NS' THEN CASE WHEN BidSuit IS NOT NULL AND ParContracts IS NOT NULL AND list_contains(list_transform(ParContracts, par_contract -> par_contract.Strain), BidSuit) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Par_Suit_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'NS' AND Par_Declarer < 0 THEN CASE WHEN DD_Score_Declarer IS NOT NULL AND DD_Score_Declarer = Par_Declarer THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Sacrifice_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = 'S' THEN DD_Tricks_Diff ELSE NULL END AS TDD_Value
  FROM self
  WHERE Player_ID_S IS NOT NULL AND {Elo_Col_S} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_S})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Date, session_id, Round, Board, Player_ID_E AS Player_ID, Player_Name_E AS Player_Name,
         MasterPoints_E AS MasterPoints, {Elo_Col_E} AS Elo_R_Player,
         CASE WHEN DD_Score_EW IS NULL OR Par_EW IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DD_Score_EW >= Par_EW THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS Par_Contract_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'EW' THEN CASE WHEN BidSuit IS NOT NULL AND ParContracts IS NOT NULL AND list_contains(list_transform(ParContracts, par_contract -> par_contract.Strain), BidSuit) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Par_Suit_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'EW' AND Par_Declarer < 0 THEN CASE WHEN DD_Score_Declarer IS NOT NULL AND DD_Score_Declarer = Par_Declarer THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Sacrifice_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = 'E' THEN DD_Tricks_Diff ELSE NULL END AS TDD_Value
  FROM self
  WHERE Player_ID_E IS NOT NULL AND {Elo_Col_E} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_E})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Date, session_id, Round, Board, Player_ID_W AS Player_ID, Player_Name_W AS Player_Name,
         MasterPoints_W AS MasterPoints, {Elo_Col_W} AS Elo_R_Player,
         CASE WHEN DD_Score_EW IS NULL OR Par_EW IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DD_Score_EW >= Par_EW THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS Par_Contract_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'EW' THEN CASE WHEN BidSuit IS NOT NULL AND ParContracts IS NOT NULL AND list_contains(list_transform(ParContracts, par_contract -> par_contract.Strain), BidSuit) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Par_Suit_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'EW' AND Par_Declarer < 0 THEN CASE WHEN DD_Score_Declarer IS NOT NULL AND DD_Score_Declarer = Par_Declarer THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Sacrifice_Value,
         CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction = 'W' THEN DD_Tricks_Diff ELSE NULL END AS TDD_Value
  FROM self
  WHERE Player_ID_W IS NOT NULL AND {Elo_Col_W} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_W})
),
player_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    Player_ID,
    LAST(Player_Name ORDER BY Date, session_id) AS Player_Name,
    MAX(MasterPoints) AS MasterPoints,
    AVG(Elo_R_Player) AS elo_avg,
    MAX(Elo_R_Player) AS elo_max,
    LAST(Elo_R_Player ORDER BY Date, session_id, COALESCE(Round, 0), Board) AS elo_last,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS Sessions_Played,
    AVG(Par_Suit_Value) AS Par_Suit_Rate,
    AVG(Par_Contract_Value) AS Par_Contract_Rate,
    AVG(Sacrifice_Value) AS Sacrifice_Rate,
    AVG(TDD_Value) AS DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg
  FROM player_positions
  GROUP BY Player_ID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) >= {Min_Sessions}
),
player_with_method AS (
  SELECT
    Player_ID, Player_Name, MasterPoints, Sessions_Played,
    Par_Suit_Rate, Par_Contract_Rate, Sacrifice_Rate, DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg,
    CASE '{Rating_Method}' WHEN 'Avg' THEN elo_avg WHEN 'Max' THEN elo_max ELSE elo_last END AS Player_Elo_Raw_Float
  FROM player_aggregates
),
player_with_published AS (
  SELECT
    Player_ID, Player_Name, MasterPoints,
    CAST(COALESCE(Player_Elo_Raw_Float, 0) AS INTEGER) AS Player_Elo_Raw,
    CASE
      WHEN {Prior_Sessions} <= 0 OR {Prior_Anchor} IS NULL
      THEN CAST(COALESCE(Player_Elo_Raw_Float, 0) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(ROUND((CAST(Sessions_Played AS DOUBLE) * COALESCE(Player_Elo_Raw_Float, 0) + {Prior_Sessions} * {Prior_Anchor}) / NULLIF((CAST(Sessions_Played AS DOUBLE) + {Prior_Sessions}), 0)) AS INTEGER)
    END AS Player_Elo_Published,
    Sessions_Played, Par_Suit_Rate, Par_Contract_Rate, Sacrifice_Rate, DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg
  FROM player_with_method
),
player_with_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Player_Elo_Published DESC, MasterPoints DESC, Player_ID ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Player_Elo_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MasterPoints DESC) AS INTEGER) AS MasterPoint_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Par_Suit_Rate DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Par_Suit_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Par_Contract_Rate DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Par_Contract_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Sacrifice_Rate DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Sacrifice_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS INTEGER) AS DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank
  FROM player_with_published
),
player_with_quality AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (CAST(Player_Elo_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Suit_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Contract_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank AS DOUBLE)) / 4.0 AS Quality_Score,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (CAST(Player_Elo_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Suit_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Contract_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank AS DOUBLE)) / 4.0 ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Quality_Rank
  FROM player_with_ranks
),
elo_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(Player_Elo_Published AS DOUBLE)) AS elo_mean,
         STDDEV_POP(CAST(Player_Elo_Published AS DOUBLE)) AS elo_sd
  FROM player_with_published
),
skill_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg) AS m_dd, STDDEV_POP(DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg) AS s_dd,
         AVG(Par_Suit_Rate) AS m_ps, STDDEV_POP(Par_Suit_Rate) AS s_ps,
         AVG(Par_Contract_Rate) AS m_pc, STDDEV_POP(Par_Contract_Rate) AS s_pc
  FROM player_with_published
),
player_scaled AS (
  SELECT pwq.*,
    CAST(LEAST(GREATEST(ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(elo_sd, 0) <= 0 THEN 1500.0 ELSE 1500.0 + ((CAST(Player_Elo_Published AS DOUBLE) - (elo_mean)) / (elo_sd)) * 400.0 END), 0), 3500) AS INTEGER) AS Player_Elo_Pub_Chess,
    CAST(LEAST(GREATEST(ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(elo_sd, 0) <= 0 THEN 1500.0 ELSE 1500.0 + ((CAST(Player_Elo_Raw AS DOUBLE) - (elo_mean)) / (elo_sd)) * 400.0 END), 0), 3500) AS INTEGER) AS Player_Elo_Raw_Chess,
    ( (pwq.DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg - ss.m_dd) / NULLIF(ss.s_dd, 0) + (pwq.Par_Suit_Rate - ss.m_ps) / NULLIF(ss.s_ps, 0) + (pwq.Par_Contract_Rate - ss.m_pc) / NULLIF(ss.s_pc, 0) ) / 3.0 AS Skill_Z
  FROM player_with_quality pwq CROSS JOIN elo_stats CROSS JOIN skill_stats ss
)
SELECT
  CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Player_Elo_Rank ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Player_Elo_Rank,
  Player_Elo_Pub_Chess AS Player_Elo_Score,
  Player_Elo_Raw_Chess AS Player_Elo_Raw,
  Player_Elo_Pub_Chess AS Player_Elo_Published,
  CASE WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2600 THEN 'SGM' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2500 THEN 'GM' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2400 THEN 'IM' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2300 THEN 'FM' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2200 THEN 'CM' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2000 THEN 'Expert' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 1800 THEN 'Advanced' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 1600 THEN 'Intermediate' WHEN Player_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 1400 THEN 'Novice' ELSE 'Beginner' END AS Title,
  ROUND(Skill_Z, 3) AS Skill_Z,
  Player_ID, Player_Name, CAST(MasterPoints AS INTEGER) AS MasterPoints,
  MasterPoint_Rank,
  CAST(Sessions_Played AS INTEGER) AS Sessions_Played,
  Quality_Rank,
  ROUND(Par_Suit_Rate * 100, 1) AS Par_Suit_Rate_Pct,
  Par_Suit_Rank,
  ROUND((Par_Contract_Rate + 1) * 50, 1) AS Par_Contract_Rate_Pct,
  Par_Contract_Rank,
  ROUND(Sacrifice_Rate * 100, 1) AS Sacrifice_Rate_Pct,
  Sacrifice_Rank,
  ROUND(DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg, 2) AS DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg,
  DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank
FROM player_scaled
WHERE ({Min_Skill_Z} <= -90 OR Skill_Z >= {Min_Skill_Z})
ORDER BY Player_Elo_Rank ASC
LIMIT {Top_N}

prompts.sql:
WITH pair_partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    Date, session_id, Round, Board,
    CASE WHEN Player_ID_N < Player_ID_S THEN Player_ID_N || '-' || Player_ID_S ELSE Player_ID_S || '-' || Player_ID_N END AS Pair_IDs,
    CASE WHEN Player_ID_N <= Player_ID_S THEN Player_Name_N || ' - ' || Player_Name_S ELSE Player_Name_S || ' - ' || Player_Name_N END AS Pair_Names,
    {Elo_Col_NS} AS Elo_R_Pair,
    (COALESCE(MasterPoints_N, 0) + COALESCE(MasterPoints_S, 0)) / 2.0 AS Avg_MPs,
    SQRT(COALESCE(MasterPoints_N, 0) * COALESCE(MasterPoints_S, 0)) AS Geo_MPs,
    CASE WHEN {Elo_Col_N} IS NOT NULL AND {Elo_Col_S} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_N}) AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_S}) THEN ({Elo_Col_N} + {Elo_Col_S}) / 2.0 ELSE NULL END AS Avg_Player_Elo,
    CASE WHEN DD_Score_NS IS NULL OR Par_NS IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DD_Score_NS >= Par_NS THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS Par_Contract_Value,
    CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'NS' THEN CASE WHEN BidSuit IS NOT NULL AND ParContracts IS NOT NULL AND list_contains(list_transform(ParContracts, par_contract -> par_contract.Strain), BidSuit) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Par_Suit_Value,
    CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'NS' AND Par_Declarer < 0 THEN CASE WHEN DD_Score_Declarer IS NOT NULL AND DD_Score_Declarer = Par_Declarer THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Sacrifice_Value,
    CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'NS' THEN DD_Tricks_Diff ELSE NULL END AS TDD_Value
  FROM self
  WHERE {Elo_Col_NS} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_NS})
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    Date, session_id, Round, Board,
    CASE WHEN Player_ID_E < Player_ID_W THEN Player_ID_E || '-' || Player_ID_W ELSE Player_ID_W || '-' || Player_ID_E END AS Pair_IDs,
    CASE WHEN Player_ID_E <= Player_ID_W THEN Player_Name_E || ' - ' || Player_Name_W ELSE Player_Name_W || ' - ' || Player_Name_E END AS Pair_Names,
    {Elo_Col_EW} AS Elo_R_Pair,
    (COALESCE(MasterPoints_E, 0) + COALESCE(MasterPoints_W, 0)) / 2.0 AS Avg_MPs,
    SQRT(COALESCE(MasterPoints_E, 0) * COALESCE(MasterPoints_W, 0)) AS Geo_MPs,
    CASE WHEN {Elo_Col_E} IS NOT NULL AND {Elo_Col_W} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_E}) AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_W}) THEN ({Elo_Col_E} + {Elo_Col_W}) / 2.0 ELSE NULL END AS Avg_Player_Elo,
    CASE WHEN DD_Score_EW IS NULL OR Par_EW IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DD_Score_EW >= Par_EW THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS Par_Contract_Value,
    CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'EW' THEN CASE WHEN BidSuit IS NOT NULL AND ParContracts IS NOT NULL AND list_contains(list_transform(ParContracts, par_contract -> par_contract.Strain), BidSuit) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Par_Suit_Value,
    CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'EW' AND Par_Declarer < 0 THEN CASE WHEN DD_Score_Declarer IS NOT NULL AND DD_Score_Declarer = Par_Declarer THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NULL END AS Sacrifice_Value,
    CASE WHEN Declarer_Pair_Direction = 'EW' THEN DD_Tricks_Diff ELSE NULL END AS TDD_Value
  FROM self
  WHERE {Elo_Col_EW} IS NOT NULL AND NOT isnan({Elo_Col_EW})
),
pair_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    Pair_IDs, LAST(Pair_Names ORDER BY Date, session_id) AS Pair_Names,
    AVG(Elo_R_Pair) AS elo_avg,
    MAX(Elo_R_Pair) AS elo_max,
    LAST(Elo_R_Pair ORDER BY Date, session_id, COALESCE(Round, 0), Board) AS elo_last,
    AVG(Avg_MPs) AS Avg_MPs, AVG(Geo_MPs) AS Geo_MPs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS Sessions,
    AVG(Avg_Player_Elo) AS Avg_Player_Elo,
    AVG(Par_Suit_Value) AS Par_Suit_Rate,
    AVG(Par_Contract_Value) AS Par_Contract_Rate,
    AVG(Sacrifice_Value) AS Sacrifice_Rate,
    AVG(TDD_Value) AS DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg
  FROM pair_partnerships
  GROUP BY Pair_IDs
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) >= {Min_Sessions}
),
pair_with_method AS (
  SELECT
    Pair_IDs, Pair_Names, Avg_MPs, Geo_MPs, Sessions, Avg_Player_Elo,
    Par_Suit_Rate, Par_Contract_Rate, Sacrifice_Rate, DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg,
    CASE '{Rating_Method}' WHEN 'Avg' THEN elo_avg WHEN 'Max' THEN elo_max ELSE elo_last END AS Pair_Elo_Raw_Float
  FROM pair_aggregates
),
pair_with_published AS (
  SELECT
    Pair_IDs, Pair_Names,
    CAST(COALESCE(Pair_Elo_Raw_Float, 0) AS INTEGER) AS Pair_Elo_Raw,
    CASE
      WHEN {Prior_Sessions} <= 0 OR {Prior_Anchor} IS NULL
      THEN CAST(COALESCE(Pair_Elo_Raw_Float, 0) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE CAST(ROUND((CAST(Sessions AS DOUBLE) * COALESCE(Pair_Elo_Raw_Float, 0) + {Prior_Sessions} * {Prior_Anchor}) / NULLIF((CAST(Sessions AS DOUBLE) + {Prior_Sessions}), 0)) AS INTEGER)
    END AS Pair_Elo_Published,
    Avg_MPs, Geo_MPs, Sessions, Avg_Player_Elo,
    Par_Suit_Rate, Par_Contract_Rate, Sacrifice_Rate, DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg
  FROM pair_with_method
),
pair_with_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    Pair_IDs, Pair_Names, Pair_Elo_Raw, Pair_Elo_Published,
    Avg_MPs, Geo_MPs, Sessions, Avg_Player_Elo,
    Par_Suit_Rate, Par_Contract_Rate, Sacrifice_Rate, DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Pair_Elo_Published DESC, Avg_MPs DESC, Pair_IDs ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Pair_Elo_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Avg_Player_Elo DESC NULLS LAST) AS INTEGER) AS Avg_Elo_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Avg_MPs DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Avg_MPs_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Geo_MPs DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Geo_MPs_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Par_Suit_Rate DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Par_Suit_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Par_Contract_Rate DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Par_Contract_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Sacrifice_Rate DESC) AS INTEGER) AS Sacrifice_Rank,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS INTEGER) AS DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank
  FROM pair_with_published
),
pair_with_quality AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    (CAST(Pair_Elo_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Suit_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Contract_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank AS DOUBLE)) / 4.0 AS Quality_Score,
    CAST(RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (CAST(Pair_Elo_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Suit_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(Par_Contract_Rank AS DOUBLE) + CAST(DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank AS DOUBLE)) / 4.0 ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Quality_Rank
  FROM pair_with_ranks
),
elo_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(Pair_Elo_Published AS DOUBLE)) AS elo_mean,
         STDDEV_POP(CAST(Pair_Elo_Published AS DOUBLE)) AS elo_sd
  FROM pair_with_published
),
skill_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg) AS m_dd, STDDEV_POP(DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg) AS s_dd,
         AVG(Par_Suit_Rate) AS m_ps, STDDEV_POP(Par_Suit_Rate) AS s_ps,
         AVG(Par_Contract_Rate) AS m_pc, STDDEV_POP(Par_Contract_Rate) AS s_pc
  FROM pair_with_published
),
pair_scaled AS (
  SELECT pwq.*,
    CAST(LEAST(GREATEST(ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(elo_sd, 0) <= 0 THEN 1500.0 ELSE 1500.0 + ((CAST(Pair_Elo_Published AS DOUBLE) - (elo_mean)) / (elo_sd)) * 400.0 END), 0), 3500) AS INTEGER) AS Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess,
    CAST(LEAST(GREATEST(ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(elo_sd, 0) <= 0 THEN 1500.0 ELSE 1500.0 + ((CAST(Pair_Elo_Raw AS DOUBLE) - (elo_mean)) / (elo_sd)) * 400.0 END), 0), 3500) AS INTEGER) AS Pair_Elo_Raw_Chess,
    ( (pwq.DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg - ss.m_dd) / NULLIF(ss.s_dd, 0) + (pwq.Par_Suit_Rate - ss.m_ps) / NULLIF(ss.s_ps, 0) + (pwq.Par_Contract_Rate - ss.m_pc) / NULLIF(ss.s_pc, 0) ) / 3.0 AS Skill_Z
  FROM pair_with_quality pwq CROSS JOIN elo_stats CROSS JOIN skill_stats ss
)
SELECT
  CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Pair_Elo_Rank ASC) AS INTEGER) AS Pair_Elo_Rank,
  Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess AS Pair_Elo_Score,
  Pair_Elo_Raw_Chess AS Pair_Elo_Raw,
  Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess AS Pair_Elo_Published,
  CASE WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2600 THEN 'SGM' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2500 THEN 'GM' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2400 THEN 'IM' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2300 THEN 'FM' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2200 THEN 'CM' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 2000 THEN 'Expert' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 1800 THEN 'Advanced' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 1600 THEN 'Intermediate' WHEN Pair_Elo_Pub_Chess >= 1400 THEN 'Novice' ELSE 'Beginner' END AS Title,
  ROUND(Skill_Z, 3) AS Skill_Z,
  Avg_Elo_Rank, Pair_IDs, Pair_Names,
  CAST(Avg_MPs AS INTEGER) AS Avg_MPs, Avg_MPs_Rank, Geo_MPs_Rank, CAST(Sessions AS INTEGER) AS Sessions,
  Quality_Rank,
  ROUND(Par_Suit_Rate * 100, 1) AS Par_Suit_Rate_Pct, Par_Suit_Rank,
  ROUND((Par_Contract_Rate + 1) * 50, 1) AS Par_Contract_Rate_Pct, Par_Contract_Rank,
  ROUND(Sacrifice_Rate * 100, 1) AS Sacrifice_Rate_Pct, Sacrifice_Rank,
  ROUND(DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg, 2) AS DD_Tricks_Diff_Avg, DD_Tricks_Diff_Rank
FROM pair_scaled
WHERE ({Min_Skill_Z} <= -90 OR Skill_Z >= {Min_Skill_Z})
ORDER BY Pair_Elo_Rank ASC
LIMIT {Top_N}

ToolTips.Player_Elo_Raw: Chess-scaled raw aggregate Elo before shrinkage.
ToolTips.Quality_Rank: Mean of Elo, par-suit, par-contract, and T-DD ranks.
ToolTips.Skill_Z: Pool z-score of card play and par bidding.
